title: bug: JetBrains Plan Review and Task Detail show a step's original description instead of its active amendment, yet Approve binds to the amended planRevision, so a human approves step text they never saw
description:
Filed by the 11-03 #2 defect hunt (task-2597ac6f). This is a client-wire mismatch between amend_plan_step and the CQ-F04 approval binding (task-6b978f9e, task-247fdf29). task-f56df322, which added amend_plan_step, left "amendment approval flows" out of scope.

PROBLEM
Daemon side, HEAD 946358a8:
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/amendPlanStep.ts allows an amendment on an AWAITING_APPROVAL task. :71 refuses only DONE and ARCHIVED, and :80 refuses only a COMPLETED step.
- At :109 the tool appends to step.amendments and sets activeAmendmentId. step.description is left untouched.
- state/taskStore.ts:132-139 (approvalPlanSurface) puts effectiveDescription = effectiveStepDescription(step), plus newFiles, into the approval surface. The amendment therefore bumps planRevision (derivePlanRevision, :172-182).

JetBrains side, same HEAD, under moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe:
- The plugin never reads an amendment. util/MoeJson.kt:594-605 parseImplementationStep reads description, status, affectedFiles, modifiedFiles, note, startedAt and completedAt. It skips amendments, activeAmendmentId and newFiles.
- model/Models.kt:92-101 ImplementationStep has no field for them.
- toolwindow/PlanReviewDialog.kt:392 renders JTextArea(step.description).
- :79 captures approval.onRendered(snapshotOf(task)), and :157-161 takes the revision from that task's current planRevision.
- So a Plan Review opened after an amendment shows the ORIGINAL step text, and Approve sends the AMENDED revision. The daemon's compare-and-swap accepts it. That is exactly what the CQ-F04 revision binding exists to prevent.
- BoardTaskFingerprint.kt:11-14 already keys on planRevision. The board re-renders after the amendment and hands the dialog the fresh task, so the stale text is not a cache artifact.
- toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt:452 (JBLabel("$stepNumber. ${step.description}")) shows the same original text for WORKING tasks. There, amendments are the common case: today's activity log has five amend_plan_step writes.

EVIDENCE
(a) Daemon-side repro on HEAD 946358a8, run in a git-archive snapshot under /tmp, never in the shared checkout:
`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/zzHunt2597B.wire.test.ts -t F1` prints
  [F1] wire step = {"stepId":"step-1","description":"ORIGINAL: delete nothing","status":"PENDING","affectedFiles":["src/a.ts"],"amendments":[{"amendmentId":"amend-1","description":"AMENDED: delete src/a.ts","reason":"r","amendedBy":"architect-1",...}],"activeAmendmentId":"amend-1"}
  [F1] status = AWAITING_APPROVAL planRevision 0 -> 1
  [F1] approved status = WORKING approvedPlanRevision 1
The step's description on the wire is still the original text, and approveTask with the amended revision succeeds. The test and its output are at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.wire.test.ts and /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.wire.out.txt.
(b) The client lines cited above, at 946358a8.

FIX DIRECTION
JetBrains only; the daemon stays unchanged.
- Parse amendments and activeAmendmentId in parseImplementationStep, and newFiles while there.
- Expose the effective description on the model: the active amendment's description when activeAmendmentId names one, else description. That mirrors packages/moe-daemon/src/util/planAmendments.ts effectiveStepDescription.
- Render the effective description in PlanReviewDialog and TaskDetailDialog, with a visible "amended" marker. The original text can stay reachable, e.g. in a tooltip.
- Put the effective-text rule in one place, the parser or a small helper, so both dialogs and the test use the same code.
- VS Code has its own twin of this gap. It is out of scope here.

FILES
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJson.kt
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/PlanReviewDialog.kt
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt
- test: moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt
Run Gradle only under the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease, mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box).

Two more JetBrains findings from this hunt share MoeJson.kt and Models.kt with this row, so they were held back and reported to the governor instead of filed:
- The Settings dialog ignores worktreeMode.
- The handoff header reads from/to/createdAt.

VERIFICATION
`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` (gradlew.bat on Windows), under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
definitionOfDone: MoeJson.parseImplementationStep parses amendments and activeAmendmentId, and the model exposes the effective description: the active amendment's description when activeAmendmentId names one, else description. A MoeJsonTest case built from the F1 wire step asserts the effective text "AMENDED: delete src/a.ts" and keeps the original text.

PlanReviewDialog and TaskDetailDialog render the effective description with an amended marker, both through the same parser/helper rule. A Plan Review of an amended AWAITING_APPROVAL step therefore shows the amendment's text alongside the revision it approves.
`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease, and the new test fails on HEAD 946358a8.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 1. Tests first, then the model rule and the parser. Placement matters: the governor's placement note on this row says peer rows task-40813cc1 (ProjectSettings and parseProjectSettings) and task-ac587df5 (HandoffNote, parseHandoffs and the priorHandoffs fixture) edit these same files. Keep every hunk inside the step model, parseImplementationStep, and ONE new test method.

(a) RED: tests in moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt.
- Add ONE new test method directly after `parseState preserves task runtime fields and step metadata` (about :309-359). Do not put it at the end of the file.
- Build the step from the hunt's F1 wire step (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.wire.out.txt):
  - description "ORIGINAL: delete nothing"
  - amendments [{amendmentId "amend-1", description "AMENDED: delete src/a.ts", reason "r", amendedBy "architect-1", amendedAt "2026-11-03T15:37:48.020Z"}]
  - activeAmendmentId "amend-1"
- Parse it through BOTH paths: the existing private parseTask(json) and parseState(json) helpers.
- Assert exact values: step.effectiveDescription == "AMENDED: delete src/a.ts", step.description == "ORIGINAL: delete nothing", and step.activeAmendment?.amendedBy == "architect-1".
- Cover these cases in the same method, each with an exact assertion:
  1. Two amendments with activeAmendmentId "amend-1" give amend-1's text: the ACTIVE amendment, not the latest.
  2. A dangling activeAmendmentId "amend-9" gives the original text and activeAmendment == null.
  3. amendments as a JSON object instead of an array, a non-object entry, a numeric description, a missing amendmentId, or a numeric activeAmendmentId each give the original text, with no throw and the task kept.
  4. A legacy step with no amendment keys gives effectiveDescription == description and amendments empty.
- Run it red first, under the jetbrains-gradle lease: `gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test --tests com.moe.util.MoeJsonTest --rerun`. compileTestKotlin fails on the unresolved effectiveDescription. Keep that tail; it is DoD 3's fails-on-946358a8 evidence.

(b) The ONE rule, in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt.
- Add `data class StepAmendment(val amendmentId: String, val description: String, val reason: String? = null, val amendedBy: String? = null, val amendedAt: String? = null)` directly above ImplementationStep (:92).
- Give ImplementationStep two defaulted constructor params, `val amendments: List<StepAmendment> = emptyList()` and `val activeAmendmentId: String? = null`. The defaults keep BoardApprovalTest.kt:190's named call compiling.
- Add class-body properties:
  - `val activeAmendment: StepAmendment?`: the entry whose amendmentId equals a NON-EMPTY activeAmendmentId, else null.
  - `val effectiveDescription: String get() = activeAmendment?.description ?: description`.
- This mirrors packages/moe-daemon/src/util/planAmendments.ts activeAmendment and effectiveStepDescription exactly: a dangling or blank id resolves to the original and never throws. Body properties stay out of equals and hashCode. Add a KDoc line pointing at planAmendments.ts.

(c) The parser, moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJson.kt.
- Change parseImplementationStep (:594-605) only:
  - activeAmendmentId = obj.getStrictStringOrNull("activeAmendmentId").
  - amendments = a new private parseStepAmendments(obj), placed directly below parseImplementationStep.
- parseStepAmendments:
  - A missing or non-array `amendments` gives emptyList.
  - mapNotNull skips a non-object entry, and an entry whose amendmentId or description is not a real JSON string. Use getStrictStringOrNull (:190), matching the daemon's `typeof a.description === 'string'`.
  - reason, amendedBy and amendedAt use getStrictStringOrNull.
- Both parse paths already call parseImplementationStep: parseTasks at :407-421 and parseTask at :610-624. Nothing else in MoeJson.kt changes.
- Do not touch parseHandoffs, parseProjectSettings, HandoffNote or ProjectSettings; the peer rows own them.
- The plugin never sends implementationPlan back to the daemon (MoeCommandSender sends field-level updates only), so the new fields are read-only display data.

Error handling: hand-edited .moe/tasks JSON can carry any shape.
- The parser must never throw on amendment data, and never drop the task or the step. Every malformed piece degrades to "no amendment", the original text.
- Mirror the existing try/strict-reader style in MoeJson.kt rather than bare asString or asJsonArray calls, which throw on a wrong kind.
- Case 3 of the test pins this.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 2. Render the effective text, with an amended marker, in both dialogs.

(a) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/PlanReviewDialog.kt, createStepsPanel (:378-400).
- Change `JTextArea(step.description)` to `JTextArea(step.effectiveDescription)`. JTextArea is plain text.
- When step.activeAmendment != null, add one small marker label directly under the step-status label: JBLabel(MoeBundle.message("moe.message.stepAmended", amendment.amendedBy ?: "unknown")), in the existing small font. "unknown" matches the daemon's amendedBy default.
- Give the marker toolTipText = MoeBundle.message("moe.message.stepAmendedOriginal", step.description), so the original text stays reachable.
- Do NOT move or change approval.onRendered(snapshotOf(task)) at :79. It must still run after buildReviewContent, so the captured revision is the one whose effective text is now on screen.
- Error handling: a render exception still lands in the existing createCenterPanel catch (:80-84), which keeps approval disabled (fail closed). Add no new catch that could swallow a render failure and leave Approve enabled.

(b) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt, createStepRow (:452).
- The label becomes "$stepNumber. ${step.effectiveDescription}".
- When amended, add the same marker label, with the same tooltip, to leftPanel after descLabel.
- The plan section already refreshes on task updates (:241-251), so an amendment that arrives while the dialog is open shows up with no extra code.
- Do not touch handoffBlocks (:905-918); task-ac587df5 owns it.

(c) moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties.
- Add `moe.message.stepAmended=Amended by {0}` and `moe.message.stepAmendedOriginal=Original step: {0}`.
- Put them next to moe.message.affectedFiles / moe.message.stepStatus (:110-114), not at the end of the file, so peer rows' keys merge cleanly.
- No apostrophes in the patterns. MessageFormat treats ' as a quote.

Security: never start a Swing label or tooltip string with agent-written text. A string that begins with <html> is rendered as HTML. The bundle prefix and the existing "$stepNumber. " prefix keep both strings plain.

Out of scope:
- BoardTaskFingerprint. planRevision already keys the re-render after an amendment.
- TaskCard, which shows only step counts.
- MoeToolWindowPanel.kt, which task-e44a8daf holds.
- The VS Code twin.

(2) The rule matches planAmendments.ts.

- A blank or dangling id gives the original text. An empty-string amendment description stays "", as in the daemon.
- A non-array holder gives []. Nothing throws.
(3) Every label and tooltip starts with "N. ", "Amended by " or "Original step: ". JTextArea is plain text.

Theoretical, not fixed:
(a) An ImplementationStep built by Gson's Unsafe allocator from JSON with no `amendments` key would hold a null list. Main code never Gson-deserializes a Task; only the test round-trip does, and it carries [].
(b) A plain Swing tooltip renders a long or multi-line original text on one line. This is cosmetic. Wrapping it in <html> was avoided on purpose.

comments.content:
Governor placement note (this is worktree mode, so no dependsOn edge). I raised this row to HIGH at 15:44Z: approving amended step text the human never saw defeats the CQ-F04 revision binding in CONTROL, the default mode.

Two peer rows I filed at 15:47Z edit the same JetBrains files:
- task-40813cc1 (Settings dialog and worktreeMode): ProjectSettings in Models.kt, parseProjectSettings in MoeJson.kt, and the settings-parse tests in MoeJsonTest.kt.
- task-ac587df5 (handoff header): HandoffNote in Models.kt, parseHandoffs in MoeJson.kt, handoffBlocks in TaskDetailDialog.kt, and the priorHandoffs fixture in MoeJsonTest.kt.

Please plan this row's edits inside the PlanStep/amendment model, the step parse (MoeJson.kt around 594-605) and the step rendering in PlanReviewDialog.kt and TaskDetailDialog.kt. Add new MoeJsonTest cases in their own test method, not at the end of the file, so the merge-tree squashes stay clean.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: JetBrains Plan Review and Task Detail show each step's effective instructions: the active amendment's text when amend_plan_step has set one, else the original description. An amended step carries a visible marker naming the amender, and its tooltip shows the original text. The revision that Plan Review's Approve sends is therefore the revision of the text the human actually read.
invariants: The effective-text rule lives in one place (ImplementationStep.activeAmendment/effectiveDescription) and mirrors daemon util/planAmendments.ts: the active amendment, never simply the latest; a dangling or blank id resolves to the original; parsing never throws.
Plan Review still captures the approval revision only after the plan has rendered (approval.onRendered after buildReviewContent); no approval path is added or removed.
No Swing label or tooltip string starts with agent-written text.
compatibility: Steps with no amendments, or with malformed amendment data, render exactly as before, and every task still parses.
ImplementationStep's new constructor params are defaulted, so existing named constructor calls (e.g. BoardApprovalTest.kt:190) compile unchanged.
The daemon wire shape and the plugin's outgoing commands are unchanged.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected options:
(1) Overwrite step.description with the effective text inside the parser. That loses the original text the marker and tooltip need, and it silently changes what BoardTaskFingerprint and any other reader means by description.
(2) A separate presentation-helper file. That is an extra file. A computed property on the model is already the single rule, and it is testable headlessly through MoeJsonTest.
(3) A glyph-only marker, to avoid touching MoeBundle.properties. UI text in this plugin goes through MoeBundle, and a tooltip that starts with agent text risks Swing's <html> rendering. The plan therefore has 6 files: the 6th is two adjacent bundle keys.
(4) Splitting TaskDetailDialog into its own row. The DoD requires both dialogs, through one rule.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Both parse paths go through MoeJson.parseImplementationStep: the snapshot parseTasks at :407 and the single-task parseTask at :610.
- Strict JSON-string readers already exist (getStrictStringOrNull at :190).
- The plugin never sends implementationPlan back to the daemon; MoeCommandSender sends field-level updates only.
- TaskDetailDialog rebuilds its plan section on task updates (:241-251). PlanReviewDialog instead invalidates approval and asks the user to reopen (moe.message.planReview.planChanged), so after this fix a reopen renders the amended text.
- BoardTaskFingerprint already includes planRevision, which every amendment bumps (daemon taskStore.ts approvalPlanSurface/derivePlanRevision).
- Daemon rule: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/planAmendments.ts activeAmendment/effectiveStepDescription. It picks the active amendment, not the latest, and a dangling id resolves to the original.
planningNotes.risks:
- Merge-tree conflicts with peer rows task-40813cc1 and task-ac587df5, which edit Models.kt, MoeJson.kt, MoeJsonTest.kt and TaskDetailDialog.kt elsewhere. Keep hunks local, put the test method beside the step-metadata test rather than at end of file, and put the bundle keys beside stepStatus.
- MessageFormat apostrophes in bundle patterns.
- Gradle traps on this shared Windows box: an UP-TO-DATE test task runs nothing (use --rerun), and an IPC MessageIOException is a flake (re-run once). Take the jetbrains-gradle lease around every run.
- A test asserting only non-null would pass on a no-op. Assert the exact strings.
- The VS Code twin and the board fingerprint are out of scope.

completionSummary:
JetBrains Plan Review and Task Detail now show each step's effective text: the active amendment's text, else the original. An "Amended by X" marker carries the original text in its tooltip. Plan Review's Approve therefore binds to the revision of the text the human read. The daemon is unchanged.
- Models.kt: new StepAmendment, plus ImplementationStep's defaulted `amendments` and `activeAmendmentId`. The single rule lives in two body properties:
  - `activeAmendment`: the entry the non-empty id names, never simply the latest; else null;
  - `effectiveDescription`.
  Both mirror daemon util/planAmendments.ts.
- MoeJson.kt: parseImplementationStep plus a new parseStepAmendments. They use strict string readers and never throw: malformed shapes degrade to the original text, and the task is kept.
- PlanReviewDialog and TaskDetailDialog render effectiveDescription and the marker, with two MoeBundle keys next to stepStatus. approval.onRendered is untouched.
- Test: one new MoeJsonTest method, through both parseTask and parseState. It covers:
  - the F1 wire step ("AMENDED: delete src/a.ts", original kept, amendedBy architect-1);
  - the active amendment, not the latest;
  - junk entries skipped;
  - dangling, blank, numeric-id, object-holder, non-string and legacy shapes.
- RED on the base: compileTestKotlin fails with "Unresolved reference 'effectiveDescription'".
- GREEN, run under the jetbrains-gradle lease: 39 classes, 626 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 6 pre-existing skips.
- qualityGate (parity-check + lint): exit 0.
- gradlew.bat lives in moe-jetbrains/, so the gate runs from there; the plan's root-level form cannot find it.
